moves.name:
Origin
Volt Tackle
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the field of play’s terrain turns into Electric Terrain.
Deactivation Condition: When the field of play’s terrain is no longer Electric Terrain.

Ignores passive skills that would reduce the damage of this attack. Ignores passive skills that would protect the target against a critical hit. Ignores the target’s Enduring effect. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets. Lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def by 1 stat rank when the target is paralyzed.

passives.name: Kanto Flag Bearer
passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs by 10%. Reduces attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 20%. The more allied sync pairs with the Kanto theme you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by 10% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 30%, and the maximum damage reduction is 26%.)

passives.name: Red’s Fighting Spirit
passives.description: Extends the duration of Electric Terrain when the terrain turns into Electric Terrain while the user is on the field. Quickly charges the move gauge when the terrain is Electric Terrain. Restores the user’s HP whenever its Pokémon takes an action when the terrain is Electric Terrain.

passives.name: Clutch Critical
passives.description: Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with the user’s following attacks become critical hits: Pokémon’s moves, sync move, or max moves.

passives.name: MAX Countdown 3
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 3 after using its max move.
